subject: Capture short wins and customer snippets for Sales Playbook and one-pager
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Capture short wins and customer snippets for Sales Playbook and one-pager

Team —

We need to assemble a short pack of customer 'quick wins' to drop into the playbook and the one-pager we're updating for Q3 sales enablement. Goal: 6–8 bite-sized entries (one sentence problem, one-line impact metric, and a one-line customer quote or permission to use logo). We'll use these across: one-pager slide, 30s pitch bullets, and a social snippet.

Please capture for each candidate:
- Customer name + industry
- 1-sentence problem we solved
- A single metric (e.g., "40% latency reduction" or "$130k/mo cost savings")
- One-line quote (or an ask to legal/product for permission)
- Whether we have explicit logo/quote permission and where it's stored

I've attached a template (template_win_snippet.docx) — please populate this or paste into a shared CSV.
Deadline: EOD Friday (7/30). If you already have explicit approvals from customers, flag them in the tracker.

Priority targets for this round: Acme Retail (recent Dedicated deployment), FinOne (pilot), and any SaaS customers where we saw notable latency/cost wins.

Thanks — I can help with outreach to get quick approvals.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Principal Sales Enablement Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capture short wins and customer snippets for Sales Playbook and one-pager

Adding what I have so far — I pulled three strong candidates and started outreach for two explicit quotes. Attached: collected_snippets.csv and acct_permission_tracker.xlsx. Quick summary below.

1) Acme Retail — Dedicated for checkout recommendations\   Problem: high inference cost and tail latency during peak traffic\   Impact: 38% per-token cost reduction after batching + quantization; P95 latency down from 620ms to 210ms\   Quote status: Requested — outreach in progress (Elena at Acme is the contact)

2) BrightLayer (SaaS analytics) — Hosted + Redwood Optimize\   Problem: cold-cache throughput impacted SLAs\   Impact: 2.3x throughput on busy windows, allowed 30% smaller instance footprint\   Quote status: Approved (legal signed off last quarter) — I attached the signed permission in the tracker

3) FinOne (payments pilot) — Private deploy\   Problem: data residency + predictable throughput\   Impact: sustained 750 TPS during heavy settlement windows; replaced homegrown infra\   Quote status: In flight with account team

I'll follow up with Elena and Rajiv today to get short quotes. If Priyom wants, I'll draft one-line quotes for review once I get permissions.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive, Retail & CPG | Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- collected_snippets.csv (spreadsheet)
- acct_permission_tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Elena Martinez <elena@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capture short wins and customer snippets for Sales Playbook and one-pager

Hi Marissa / Priyom,

Thanks for the reminder — happy to help. We ran the Dedicated rollout in June and the numbers below are good to use publicly. You can attribute the quote to "Acme Retail" and use our logo (high-res logo attached).

One-line quote we approve: "Redwood cut inference cost and smoothed peak checkout latency, letting us scale promotions without site slowdowns."
Key metric: 38% per-token cost reduction; P95 latency improved from ~620ms to ~210ms after batching and light quantization.

Attachment: Acme_support_metrics.png (screenshot of monitoring dashboard)
Permission: "Acme Retail" — logo and quote approved by product & comms. No further legal needed for the one-pager.

If you want a short testimonial paragraph I can provide that early next week.

Best,
Elena Martinez
Head of Infrastructure | Acme Retail

[Attachment: Acme_support_metrics.png (image)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capture short wins and customer snippets for Sales Playbook and one-pager

Perfect — thanks Elena and Marissa.

Plan / next steps:
- Marissa: please add the Acme quote and Acme_support_metrics.png to the playbook Drive folder and mark the tracker as "approved".
- Karthik: can you draft 1 slide (30–45s story) and a single-line snippet for the one-pager? Use the quote exactly as Elena wrote it; we have logo permission.
- Sean: please pull the BrightLayer permission file into the shared folder (it was signed Q2) and confirm the final metric wording.

I've created a folder and starter deck here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d_playbook-graphics — please drop final assets by Wednesday next week. We'll publish the one-pager to the sales portal after quick QA.

If anyone needs me to chase a quote or route to comms/legal, ping me and I'll take it.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Principal Sales Enablement Manager | Redwood Inference
